---
name: Bug report
about: Report a defect — wrong output, panic, crash, hang, incorrect tool behavior
title: ''
labels: bug
---

**Version**
Output of `mcp-librarian --version` (or commit hash if from source).

**OS**
Windows / macOS / Linux + version.

**MCP client**
Claude Code / Claude Desktop / Codex / other (with version).

**What I did**
Exact tool call(s) or CLI command, ideally copy-pasted from the agent transcript.

**What happened**
Output / error message / what the client showed. Logs if you have them (`RUST_LOG=debug`).

**What I expected**
One sentence.

**Notes**
Anything else that might help — a minimal repro manifest, the contents of `%APPDATA%\netviper\mcp-librarian\config\manifests\<server>.toml`, etc.
